title: Oakhaven level 3 · SRD 5.1
party: Calder Voss (Fighter), Ness Quinn (Rogue), Halden Moss (Cleric), Mira Quill (Wizard)

carryForward.name: Wand of Secrets
carryForward.text: Uncommon. No attunement in SRD 5.2. 3 charges, regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. Magic action (2024) / an action (2014): if a secret door or trap is within 60 feet, the wand pulses and points at the nearest one. 2014 action name was not re-copied from an SRD 5.1 PDF in this pass; charge count and range match the confirmed 5.2 text.

carryForward.name: Cloak of Protection
carryForward.text: Uncommon, requires attunement. +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while worn. Oakhaven calls it the Saltglass Cloak. The bonus matches SRD 5.2 and the SRD 5.1 Cloak of Protection.

dropInNote: These four are the series party. They carry every permanent SRD magic item earned on the best path of each earlier Oakhaven module. Consumables are not assumed to remain. A table that drops in without those modules can set the extra items aside. SRD 5.2 Starting at Higher Levels gives a smaller default kit (levels 2–4: one common item; levels 5–10: one common and one uncommon). The series kit is earned treasure, not that starting package.
unsettledRules: SRD 5.1 does not include the 2014 Dungeon Master's Guide Easy/Medium/Hard/Deadly XP threshold table or the encounter multiplier. These sheets do not invent one.
Boots of Elvenkind attunement in SRD 5.1 was not re-read from a 5.1 PDF. SRD 5.2 prints no attunement line.

2014 Beacon of Hope is on the Life Domain list at cleric level 5. Its effect text was not copied onto the sheet. 2014 Spiritual Weapon is on the Life list at cleric level 3 and was also left off the sheet. Use the SRD 5.1 text at the table. 2024 Life Domain does not prepare either spell; at level 5 it prepares Mass Healing Word and Revivify.
2014 Hunter Shark and Giant Constrictor attack lines that differ from SRD 5.2 are called out in the adventures, not guessed onto these sheets.
2024 Cure Wounds is 2d8 + modifier and Healing Word is 2d4 + modifier. 2014 is 1d8 + modifier and 1d4 + modifier.
2024 Lesser Restoration is a Bonus Action and does not mention disease. 2014 is an action and can end one disease.

2024 subclasses begin at level 3. 2014 Life Domain is level 1. 2014 Evocation school is level 2. 2014 Champion and Thief are level 3. Do not give a level-2 2014 fighter Improved Critical or a level-2 2014 rogue Fast Hands.

characters.name: Calder Voss
characters.role: Front line. Holds the door and the wounded.
characters.acNotes: Chain mail 16 + shield 2 + Defense 1 = 19. No magic weapon yet.

attackList.name: Longsword
attackList.notes: Versatile 1d10+3. 2014: no weapon mastery. One attack with the Attack action.

featureList.name: Fighting Style: Defense
featureList.text: While wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, +1 AC. Included in AC 19.

featureList.name: Second Wind
featureList.text: Bonus Action: regain 1d10 + 3 HP. Once per Short Rest.

featureList.name: Oakhaven Watch
featureList.text: The east gate will read you the day's duty slate. No extra mechanic.

featureList.name: Action Surge
featureList.text: On your turn, take one additional action. Once per Short Rest. The 2014 feature does not exclude casting a spell.

featureList.name: Improved Critical
featureList.text: Weapon attacks score a critical hit on 19–20. 2014 Champion does not grant Remarkable Athlete until level 7.

personality.trait: Counts doors, spears, and people before he counts treasure.
personality.ideal: The town stands if somebody holds the line.
personality.bond: Oakhaven's east gate taught him the job.
personality.flaw: He will not leave a fallen person to make a cleaner retreat.

characters.appearance: Broad human in chain mail, shield scarred, voice flat and brief.
characters.features: Fighting Style: Defense; Second Wind; Oakhaven Watch; Action Surge; Improved Critical

characters.name: Ness Quinn
characters.role: Locks, scouting, and the wand that finds traps.

attackList.name: Shortsword
attackList.notes: Finesse. Sneak Attack +2d6 once per turn when it qualifies.

attackList.name: Dagger
attackList.notes: Finesse, light, thrown 20/60. Two-weapon fighting uses a bonus action and does not add Dex to the off-hand damage.

bonusActions: Cunning Action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide

featureList.name: Expertise
featureList.text: Double proficiency on Stealth and Sleight of Hand.

featureList.name: Sneak Attack
featureList.text: Once per turn, +2d6 weapon damage with a Finesse or ranged weapon if you have Advantage, or if an ally is within 5 feet of the target and you do not have Disadvantage. 2024 ally must not be Incapacitated. 2014 ally must not be incapacitated.

featureList.name: Cunning Action
featureList.text: Bonus Action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide. 2014 has no Steady Aim and no Cunning Strike.

featureList.name: Fast Hands
featureList.text: Bonus Action: Sleight of Hand, use an object, or use thieves' tools to disarm a trap or open a lock.

featureList.name: Second-Story Work
featureList.text: Climbing does not cost extra movement. A running long jump uses Dexterity.

personality.trait: Names the exit before she names the treasure.
personality.ideal: A locked door is a question, not an insult.
personality.bond: The eastern lane still knows her knock.
personality.flaw: She will open the box before anyone agrees.

characters.appearance: Lean human in studded leather, ink on two fingers, boots quieter than the floor.
characters.features: Expertise; Sneak Attack; Cunning Action; Fast Hands; Second-Story Work
characters.gear: Studded leather, Shortsword, 2 daggers, Thieves' tools, Wand of Secrets

magicItems.name: Wand of Secrets
magicItems.text: Uncommon. No attunement in SRD 5.2. 3 charges, regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. Magic action (2024) / an action (2014): if a secret door or trap is within 60 feet, the wand pulses and points at the nearest one. 2014 action name was not re-copied from an SRD 5.1 PDF in this pass; charge count and range match the confirmed 5.2 text.

characters.name: Halden Moss
characters.role: Keeps people alive and answers the shrine.
characters.acNotes: Chain mail 16 + shield 2 = 18 + Cloak of Protection 1 = 19. Cloak also adds +1 to every saving throw.

attackList.name: Mace
attackList.notes: One melee attack. Spellcasting is the better action most rounds.

attackList.name: Sacred Flame
attackList.notes: Dexterity save DC 13, not an attack roll.

spellcasting.prepareCount: SRD 5.1 prepared count is 6 (Wis mod + cleric level); domain spells are extra. This sheet prints only spells whose text was checked. Fill any empty slots from the SRD cleric list. Spiritual Weapon is on the 2014 Life list at level 3 and is not printed here.

spellList.name: Sacred Flame
spellList.effect: Dex save DC 13 or 1d8 radiant. Cover does not help. Cantrip die becomes 2d8 at level 5 in both editions.

spellList.name: Guidance
spellList.effect: Concentration, 1 minute. Touch: the target may add 1d4 to one ability check before the spell ends.

spellList.name: Light
spellList.effect: One object sheds bright light 20 ft. and dim light 20 ft. for 1 hour.

spellList.name: Cure Wounds
spellList.effect: One creature regains 1d8 + 3 HP. 2024 is 2d8 + mod; 2014 is 1d8 + mod. Disciple of Life adds 2 + slot level when that feature is on this sheet.

spellList.name: Healing Word
spellList.effect: One creature you can see regains 1d4 + 3 HP. 2024 is 2d4 + mod; 2014 is 1d4 + mod.

spellList.name: Bless
spellList.effect: Concentration, 1 minute. Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.

spellList.name: Shield of Faith
spellList.effect: Concentration, 10 minutes. One creature gains +2 AC.

spellList.name: Lesser Restoration
spellList.effect: End one disease or the Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned condition. Action, not a bonus action.

featureList.name: Life Domain
featureList.text: Heavy armor proficiency. Disciple of Life: when a 1st-level or higher spell restores HP, the creature regains extra HP equal to 2 + the spell's level.

featureList.name: Disciple of Life
featureList.text: Healing spells of 1st level or higher restore an extra 2 + spell level HP. 2024 moves this feature to level 3.

featureList.name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
featureList.text: Restore 15 HP divided among creatures within 30 feet, none above half their maximum. Also Turn Undead. Uses: 1 per short rest.

personality.trait: Asks who is hurt before he asks what is evil.
personality.ideal: A prayer that does not help a body is unfinished.
personality.bond: The chapel at Oakhaven still has his spare robe.
personality.flaw: He will spend the last slot on a stranger.

characters.appearance: Weathered human in chain mail under a plain cloak, holy symbol worn smooth.
characters.features: Life Domain; Disciple of Life; Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
characters.gear: Chain mail, Shield, Mace, Holy symbol, Cloak of Protection

magicItems.name: Cloak of Protection
magicItems.text: Uncommon, requires attunement. +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while worn. Oakhaven calls it the Saltglass Cloak. The bonus matches SRD 5.2 and the SRD 5.1 Cloak of Protection.

characters.name: Mira Quill
characters.role: Control, fire, and the spell the party is missing.
characters.acNotes: Unarmored 10 + Dex 2 until Mage Armor: base AC 13 + Dex = 15.

attackList.name: Dagger
attackList.notes: Finesse, thrown 20/60. Use only if a spell is wrong.

spellList.name: Fire Bolt
spellList.effect: Ranged spell attack +5, 1d10 fire. A flammable unattended object starts burning.

spellList.name: Prestidigitation
spellList.effect: A minor sensory effect: clean, soil, warm, chill, flavor, or a mark, lasting up to 1 hour.

spellList.name: Ray of Frost
spellList.effect: Ranged spell attack +5, 1d8 cold, and the target's speed drops by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

spellList.name: Mage Armor
spellList.effect: 8 hours. A willing unarmored creature's base AC becomes 13 + Dex modifier. On Mira that is 15.

spellList.name: Shield
spellList.effect: When you are hit by an attack or targeted by Magic Missile: +5 AC until the start of your next turn, including against the triggering attack, and Magic Missile deals no damage.

spellList.name: Magic Missile
spellList.effect: Three darts, each 1d4+1 force, hitting automatically. You may split them. +1 dart per slot level above 1.

spellList.name: Thunderwave
spellList.effect: Con save DC 13: 2d8 thunder and pushed 10 feet, or half damage and not pushed on a success.

spellList.name: Misty Step
spellList.effect: Teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

spellList.name: Scorching Ray
spellList.effect: Three rays, each a ranged spell attack +5 for 2d6 fire. One extra ray per slot level above 2.

featureList.name: Arcane Recovery
featureList.text: Once per Long Rest, at the end of a Short Rest, recover expended slots whose total levels do not exceed 2 and none of which is 6th level or higher.

featureList.name: Ritual Adept
featureList.text: You can cast a ritual from your spellbook without preparing it. 2024 names this Ritual Adept; 2014 is part of Spellcasting. Read from the book.

featureList.name: Sculpt Spells
featureList.text: When you cast an evocation spell that affects other creatures you can see, choose 1 + the spell's level of them. They automatically succeed and take no damage. 2024 moves Sculpt Spells to level 6.

featureList.name: Evocation Savant
featureList.text: Copying evocation spells into the spellbook costs half the usual gold and time.

personality.trait: Reads the label before she touches the bottle.
personality.ideal: A spell you cannot explain is a spell you should not cast yet.
personality.bond: Kaelen's drying room still has her old stool.
personality.flaw: She will spend the slot to learn what the thing is.

characters.appearance: Sharp-eyed human with a soot-marked spellbook and a staff wrapped in linen.
characters.features: Arcane Recovery; Ritual Adept; Sculpt Spells; Evocation Savant
characters.gear: Quarterstaff (arcane focus), Dagger, Spellbook, Component pouch
